newer_changes_search: Web search (2026-10-26) and the PIB Cabinet release of 14 Oct 2026 (in the snapshots): NFBS is renamed Pradhan Mantri Parivar Labh Yojana and continues 'in its existing form' (Rs 20,000 lump sum on the death of the breadwinner aged >18 and <60). The scheme file reflects the rename. No other change found.

findings.note: Marked mandatory, but NSAP guideline §5.2.12 says no beneficiary is to be denied for lacking a bank account. Aadhaar is correctly optional here.
As for the other NSAP schemes, card vs BPL status (§3.1.3).
findings.suggestion: Consider confidence 'uncertain' for the bpl rule.

findings.note: The Cabinet release spells the Hindi name 'प्रधानमंत्री पारिवार लाभ योजना'; the content uses 'परिवार'. The content's spelling is the normal Hindi word, and the PIB form looks like a typo.
findings.suggestion: Keep as is, or match the official spelling. Either is acceptable.
